run_create_vasp_inputs_relax: run the CLI to generate VASP relaxation input files from a directory of CIF structure files
run_create_vasp_inputs_static: run the CLI to generate VASP static calculation input files from CIF files with a custom output directory
run_create_vasp_inputs_custom_incar: run the CLI to generate VASP inputs using a custom INCAR YAML settings directory path
create_input_generator_relax: create a RelaxSetGenerator with user INCAR settings from a YAML file and PBE_54_W_HASH pseudopotentials
create_input_generator_static: create a StaticSetGenerator with user INCAR settings from a YAML file and PBE_54_W_HASH pseudopotentials
